content:
We have a new point release, v4.32.1. It fixes a soundness bug in the kernel that was discovered by Patrick Hulin with the help of GPT-5.6 Sol.

This bug can be used by a malicious meta program to trick the kernel into accepting a proof of False, or any other theorem. It requires the malicious meta program to run in the same process as the kernel. In that situation, malicious meta programs already have other, blunter, ways to let the system accept bad proofs, so this bug does not create a new attack vector.

The recommended way to check possibly dishonest proofs using comparator is not affected by this bug, as you can see on comparator.live.lean-lang.org.

See issue lean#14484 for more details on the bug and PR lean#14498 for the fix.

Depending on your threat model, you may want to update your toolchain to v4.32.1. Versions of mathlib and cslib tagged v4.32.1 are also available.

If you have questions or concerns, feel free to use #general > Discussion: Lean v4.32.1
